mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) total_matches, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_order o JOIN match_stats s ON s.match_id=o.match_id) total_orders, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_order o JOIN match_stats s ON s.match_id=o.match_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('PAID','REFUND_PENDING')) paid_orders, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_order o JOIN match_stats s ON s.match_id=o.match_id WHERE o.order_status='REFUNDED') refunded_orders, COALESCE(SUM(valid_sold_count),0) valid_tickets_sold, COALESCE(SUM(checked_in_count),0) checked_in_tickets, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(gross_sales_amount),0) AS DECIMAL(14,2)) gross_sales_amount, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(refund_amount),0) AS DECIMAL(14,2)) refund_amount, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(net_sales_amount),0) AS DECIMAL(14,2)) net_sales_amount, CAST(COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(attendance_rate),2),0) AS DECIMAL(7,2)) average_attendance_rate FROM match_stats
SELECT * FROM match_stats ORDER BY match_time DESC,match_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT z.match_zone_id,z.zone_name_snapshot zone_name,z.ticket_price, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM match_seat_inventory i WHERE i.match_zone_id=z.match_zone_id AND i.inventory_status!='DISABLED') total_seat_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_item oi JOIN ticket_order o ON o.order_id=oi.order_id WHERE o.match_zone_id=z.match_zone_id AND oi.item_status='PAID') valid_sold_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_item oi JOIN ticket_order o ON o.order_id=oi.order_id WHERE o.match_zone_id=z.match_zone_id AND oi.item_status='REFUNDED') refunded_count, CAST(CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM match_seat_inventory i WHERE i.match_zone_id=z.match_zone_id AND i.inventory_status!='DISABLED')=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_item oi JOIN ticket_order o ON o.order_id=oi.order_id WHERE o.match_zone_id=z.match_zone_id AND oi.item_status='PAID')*100.0/ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM match_seat_inventory i WHERE i.match_zone_id=z.match_zone_id AND i.inventory_status!='DISABLED'),2) END AS DECIMAL(7,2)) ticket_sale_rate FROM match_ticket_zone z WHERE z.match_id=#{matchId} ORDER BY z.match_zone_id

SELECT c.club_id,c.club_name,COUNT(s.match_id) home_match_count, COALESCE(SUM(s.valid_sold_count),0) valid_tickets_sold, COALESCE(SUM(s.checked_in_count),0) checked_in_tickets, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(s.gross_sales_amount),0) AS DECIMAL(14,2)) gross_sales_amount, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(s.refund_amount),0) AS DECIMAL(14,2)) refund_amount, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(s.net_sales_amount),0) AS DECIMAL(14,2)) net_sales_amount, CAST(COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(s.ticket_sale_rate),2),0) AS DECIMAL(7,2)) average_ticket_sale_rate, CAST(COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(s.attendance_rate),2),0) AS DECIMAL(7,2)) average_attendance_rate FROM club_info c LEFT JOIN match_stats s ON s.home_club_id=c.club_id WHERE c.club_id=#{clubScope} GROUP BY c.club_id,c.club_name ORDER BY valid_tickets_sold DESC,c.club_id
SELECT * FROM match_stats ORDER BY valid_sold_count DESC,net_sales_amount DESC,match_time,match_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) total_applications, SUM(r.refund_status='PENDING') pending_count, SUM(r.refund_status='APPROVED') approved_count, SUM(r.refund_status='REJECTED') rejected_count, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.refund_status='APPROVED' THEN r.refund_amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS DECIMAL(14,2)) approved_refund_amount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.order_id) FROM payment_record p JOIN ticket_order po ON po.order_id=p.order_id JOIN match_info pm ON pm.match_id=po.match_id WHERE p.pay_status='SUCCESS' AND pm.season_id=#{q.seasonId} AND p.pay_time>=#{q.startTime}AND p.pay_time<=#{q.endTime}) successful_paid_orders, CAST(CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.order_id) FROM payment_record p JOIN ticket_order po ON po.order_id=p.order_id JOIN match_info pm ON pm.match_id=po.match_id WHERE p.pay_status='SUCCESS' AND pm.season_id=#{q.seasonId} AND p.pay_time>=#{q.startTime}AND p.pay_time<=#{q.endTime})=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(r.refund_status='APPROVED')*100.0/(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.order_id) FROM payment_record p JOIN ticket_order po ON po.order_id=p.order_id JOIN match_info pm ON pm.match_id=po.match_id WHERE p.pay_status='SUCCESS' AND pm.season_id=#{q.seasonId} AND p.pay_time>=#{q.startTime}AND p.pay_time<=#{q.endTime}),2) END AS DECIMAL(7,2)) refund_rate FROM refund_apply r JOIN ticket_order o ON o.order_id=r.order_id JOIN match_info m ON m.match_id=o.match_id WHERE 1=1 AND m.season_id=#{q.seasonId} AND r.created_at>=#{q.startTime}AND r.created_at<=#{q.endTime}

SELECT COUNT(*) total_attempts,SUM(c.check_result='SUCCESS') success_count,SUM(c.check_result!='SUCCESS') failed_count, CAST(CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(c.check_result='SUCCESS')*100.0/COUNT(*),2) END AS DECIMAL(7,2)) success_rate, SUM(c.check_result='CODE_NOT_FOUND') code_not_found_count,SUM(c.check_result='WRONG_MATCH') wrong_match_count, SUM(c.check_result='ORDER_INVALID') order_invalid_count,SUM(c.check_result='TICKET_USED') ticket_used_count, SUM(c.check_result='TICKET_REFUNDED') ticket_refunded_count,SUM(c.check_result='TICKET_VOID') ticket_void_count FROM checkin_record c JOIN match_info m ON m.match_id=c.match_id WHERE 1=1 AND m.season_id=#{q.seasonId} AND c.check_time>=#{q.startTime}AND c.check_time<=#{q.endTime}
